SL-004 is implemented and committed as `f19604f`. `npm test` passes (32 of 32) and `npm run typecheck` is clean. I wrote `tests/titles.test.ts` first and ran it against the old code. 13 tests failed. They pass after the implementation. - **Backend** (`src/tasks.ts`, `src/app.ts`): - A new `validateTitle` trims the title and rejects anything that isn't a string, is empty after trimming, or is over 500 characters. - `POST /api/tasks` now answers 400 with the error codes and messages from `contracts/tasks-api.md` and stores nothing. A body that isn't valid JSON gets `invalid_json`. - A title of exactly 500 characters is accepted. - I counted length in code points rather than UTF-16 units, so an emoji counts as one character. - `createTask` no longer trims, because the validator now does it. - **Frontend** (`public/index.html`, `public/app.js`): there is a new `

`. The form shows the server's `error.message` there with `textContent`, keeps what the owner typed on failure, and clears the message and the field on success. - **Database layer:** untouched, as the slice requires. I didn't open the page in a browser. The page tests only check that the markup and script are wired to `#form-message`. I also left `status: planned` in the slice file as it was, since you didn't ask me to change it.
